title.en: Seedream 5.0 Pro, Qwen Image 3.0, Grok Imagine Image 2.0, Kling O3, Omni 1.1, PixVerse v6, Vidu Q3
title.zh: Seedream 5.0 Pro、Qwen Image 3.0、Grok Imagine Image 2.0、Kling O3、Omni 1.1、PixVerse v6、Vidu Q3

summary.en: Seven image and video models are live on OmniMux.
summary.zh: 七个图像 / 视频模型已在 OmniMux 可调用。

body.en:
## Image

- **Model IDs:** `seedream-5.0-pro`, `qwen-image-3.0`, `grok-imagine-image-2.0`
- **API:** `POST /v1/images/generations`

## Video

- **Model IDs:** `kling-o3`, `gemini-omni-1.1`, `pixverse-v6`, `vidu-q3`
- **API:** async `POST` / `GET` `/v1/video/generations`

`kling-o3` is a new id and does not replace `kling-v3`. `gemini-omni-1.1` is distinct from `gemini-omni-flash`. Pin IDs from live pricing.
body.zh:
## 图像

- **模型 ID：** `seedream-5.0-pro`、`qwen-image-3.0`、`grok-imagine-image-2.0`
- **API：** `POST /v1/images/generations`

## 视频

- **模型 ID：** `kling-o3`、`gemini-omni-1.1`、`pixverse-v6`、`vidu-q3`
- **API：** 异步 `POST` / `GET` `/v1/video/generations`

`kling-o3` 是新 ID，不覆盖 `kling-v3`。`gemini-omni-1.1` 与 `gemini-omni-flash` 不同。精确 ID 以线上定价为准。
